name: @cortexkit/pi-anthropic-auth
description: Pi package for CortexKit Anthropic OAuth support. It overrides Pi's built-in `anthropic` provider with a CortexKit provider extension backed by the shared `@cortexkit/anthropic-auth-core` package.
